Implementation Summary
The Intelligent Research Assistant integrates modern Natural Language Processing, se-
mantic search, vector databases, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation into a unified
application. The modular implementation enables efficient document indexing, intelli-
gent retrieval, and context-aware answer generation while ensuring transparency through
citation-based responses.
5.21
Frontend Implementation
The frontend of the Intelligent Research Assistant has been developed using HTML, CSS,
JavaScript, and Jinja2 templates provided by the FastAPI framework. The user interface
is designed to provide a simple and responsive experience for researchers while interacting
with the system.
The application contains the following web pages:
• Login Page
• Registration Page
• Dashboard
• Chat Interface
• Document Upload Page
The frontend communicates with the backend through RESTful API calls using
JavaScript. Authentication tokens are securely stored after successful login and are in-
cluded in every protected request.
5.22
Database Implementation
The system uses SQLite during development and supports PostgreSQL for production
deployment.
SQLAlchemy ORM is used to perform all database operations.
The major database tables are:
• Users
• Sessions
• Workspaces
